description: How many reviewed questions the Open Trivia Database holds in one category, split into easy, medium and hard, so a quiz round can be planned without asking for more questions than exist (some categories hold only a few dozen hard questions). Counts cover multiple-choice and true/false together; the API does not split them by question type. (cost: 1 credit)

category.description: string or integer, required, category id (9-32) or name such as "sports", "geography", "film"

name: trivia_question_count
